structure.unit: State Agencies Related to the General Operation of Government

law.catch_line: Commonwealth shall not be liable for loss in collection of checks, etc
law.text: The Commonwealth shall not be liable for any loss resulting from lack of diligence on the part of any depository in forwarding, or in failing to collect, any check, draft, or electronic transfer of funds as is referred to in § 2.2-1804, or for the loss of any check, draft, or electronic transfer of funds in transmission through the mails or otherwise.
